column1: # The registry files that follow a repository's releases (tools/collect.sh). One per line, separated by tabs:
# "steinmods.json" is a mod's index, "update.json" the Stein Client's, "installer" the "latest" and "test.loader" of
# stein.json, "packs" the pack history (packs.json). The fourth column starts the version history the Stein Client
# offers (tools/history.py): releases from that tag on, never earlier. An official mod also needs its index in
# "sources" of stein.json; an extra (Keybind, Minimap, Mouse, Combat) is added by the player with its registry link.
